notes.title: Assau!t (2023) Update 20230916
notes.content:
Updated Assau!t (2023).

1. You have set your physical strength to recover when you switch to sitting mode.
2. Enemy bullet judgments now result in player damage when colliding with the player (traditional enemy bullet judgments are to be damaged when reaching the player's territory)
3. Improved weapon firing speed.

+ Additional information
1. Fixed a bug where the game mode does not change in the change mode of pause.

notes.title: Assau!t Day 0 update
notes.content:
[u][b](This content is translated by Google Translator. Some translations are wrong. please understand.)[/b][/u]

[h3]Hello! This is CyberApex.
Thank you for your interest in the upcoming release of Assau!t.[/h3]

Nothing else, before preparing for Assau!t, which will be released on January 29, 2021,
We added game modes to be added and updated build files.

Originally, it was scheduled to be updated from early to mid February 2021,
We work on some updates in advance to test the parts that were pre-released,
Submitted the build file. Accordingly, the rest will be updated from early to mid-February.

Currently, the update is in progress.

[h1][b]The updated content is as follows.[/b][/h1]

[b]1. Add Countmode[/b]
-We have added a game mode that contains limited elements of the BasicMode.

[b][h3] What is Countmode?[/h3][/b]
Unlike the BasicMode, the CountMode is a mode with limited game systems and controls.

If an enemy passes over the border area, the game is over immediately.
(Basic mode reduces damage and score, and changes its position to sponge point)

Also, the item cannot be used, and the number of target kills is included.
(Random number is placed from 30 to 60)

About saving the score...
-In-game high score data is composed of basic mode and count mode integrated.
If there is a lot of problem feedback on this part, it will be fixed in the future.

[b] Thank you for reading. See you on January 29th.[/b]
[i] -!CyberApex, SkagoGames 2021[/i]
